_comment: The real kit. Edit freely — this file is the single source for the /gear/ page and for `gear:` references in post front matter. Affiliate URLs are intentionally empty: add them and, once AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG is set, bare amazon.* links get the tag appended automatically at build time. Set `featured: true` on the handful you want on the homepage.

items.name: Nikon D3400
items.blurb: Entry-level APS-C DSLR that keeps outliving the reviews declaring it obsolete.
items.why: The sensor is bigger than a phone's and the F mount is decades deep in cheap fast glass. That combination still isn't beatable at the price.

items.name: DJI Action 2 (Power Mod + macro lens)
items.blurb: The magnetic modular cube. Power Mod for runtime, macro lens for close-up work, no display mod.
items.why: Nothing else this small mounts anywhere. The macro lens in particular gets shots the phone simply cannot.

items.name: DJI Action 6
items.blurb: The current generation, and the conventional one after the Action 2 experiment.
items.why: Does the boring things well, which after four years of the cube is the point.

items.name: DJI Mic Mini
items.blurb: Wireless lav small enough to leave clipped on and forget about.
items.why: Audio is where a small channel wins or loses viewers. This is the cheapest fix that actually sticks, because it's the one you'll bother using.

items.name: Sennheiser HD 560S
items.blurb: Open-back, neutral-leaning reference headphone. The measuring stick for everything else here.
items.why: Flat response means what I mix sounds the same elsewhere. Open-back means my ears survive a long session.

items.name: Moondrop Aria 2
items.blurb: Single dynamic driver IEM, the step-up from the budget tier.

items.name: Moondrop Chu 2 DSP
items.blurb: Budget benchmark IEM. The DSP cable carries the DAC, so it needs nothing else.
items.why: Sounds identical off any USB-C source with no dongle involved, which quietly makes it the most practical IEM in the drawer.

items.name: KZ PR1
items.blurb: Planar magnetic IEM at a price planars had no business reaching.

items.name: KZ ZEx
items.blurb: Hybrid IEM with an unusual driver arrangement.

items.name: Moondrop Dawn Pro 2
items.blurb: Dongle DAC/amp. The thing that makes the power-hungry IEMs behave.

items.name: Bose SoundLink Flex Gen 2
items.blurb: The expensive one in the collection.

items.name: Tribit StormBox Blast
items.blurb: The big one. Party-sized.

items.name: Tribit StormBox Pro
items.blurb: 360-degree mid-size.

items.name: Tribit StormBox Micro
items.blurb: The one with the strap. Bike, bag, shower.

items.name: Tribit StormBox Mini+
items.blurb: Pocketable Tribit. (Name corrected from "Mini" — Tribit's current lineup only has "Mini+"; confirm against the unit.)

items.name: Tribit MaxSound Plus
items.blurb: The long-standing value pick.

items.name: Tribit XSound Go
items.blurb: The smallest Tribit here. (Name corrected — "Pocket Go" isn't a real Tribit product; closest match is the XSound Go, confirm against the unit.)

items.name: JBL Flip 6
items.blurb: The default recommendation for most people for years running.

items.name: JBL Go 4
items.blurb: Smallest JBL.

items.name: Mivi Roam
items.blurb: Budget entry.

items.name: Mivi Play
items.blurb: Budget entry.

items.name: Xiaomi Pad 6
items.blurb: Bought to consume, ended up working on it.

items.name: Redmi Turbo 5
items.blurb: Flagship-tier chip at a price that shouldn't allow it.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy S21 FE
items.blurb: Owned long enough to know what actually degrades.
